wrong_findings.claim: Every page has a description and a canonical.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The `/gifts/` HTML has neither a meta description nor a canonical link.

wrong_findings.claim: The two Kintamani pages have identical body copy.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The 250g page has an additional sentence linking to the 1kg bag that is absent from the 1kg page. The pages are still near duplicates.

extra_true.finding: The Flores Bajawa page has no Product JSON-LD.
Flores Bajawa is not linked from the coffee hub, shop, or homepage.
The Shop page describes gear and drip bags without linking to products for them.
The Article schema lacks image and publisher fields; one headline differs from its page H1, and the author has no URL.
The Organization schema lacks sameAs, contactPoint, and openingHours.
Open Graph and Twitter Card tags are absent.
There is no favicon file in the supplied site files.
Most pages have no H2 headings, and there are no breadcrumbs or BreadcrumbList schema.
The footer omits links to the shop, subscriptions, and wholesale pages.
